Maya S.: AM standup — quick async: what I did / blockers / today
Maya S.: Did: wired depgraph feature-flag gating for rollout. Blocker: need signoff on fallback priority ordering from @Sam (PM). Today: iterate fallback spec + update docs.
Raj P.: Did: ran perf sweep on embed pipeline, saw ~8% p99 latency bump when KV cache cold. Blocker: can't repro in staging without longer-lived traces. Today: add request sampling & extended traces.
Kevin T.: Ping: CR review needed for PR #1423 (canary routing changes) — small diff, mostly tests. @Lina G. can you take a look? ETA review today noon?
Lina G.: Reviewing now, leaving a few inline notes. One ask: update rollout strategy table for burst qps and add a rollback perf assertion.
Sam (PM): @Maya S. I can sign off on fallback order but prefer a 10-min sync to confirm tradeoffs — I'm on PDT, available 11:30-12:00.
carla-dev: Heads up: infra will rotate VPN certs at 14:00 UTC. If anyone needs access to private clusters after that, fetch new creds: `ssh -i /path/to/key user@bastion` and run `./scripts/get-creds.sh`.
Deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: canary at 2026-03-18T14:00Z (job id: deploy-778). Will post live status on start/finish. :robot_face:
Maya S.: Thanks @Sam — syncing in 15. @Kevin T. once Lina approves I'll tag for canary. Please mark any non-blocking flakiness in the PR.
Kevin T.: noted — there's a Windows runner flake unrelated to rollout; will ignore for canary.
Lina G.: Left comments, approving if folks address the small test cleanup and add the rollback assertion. :thumbsup:
Raj P.: Also flag: telemetry schema change for latency traces needs opt-in flag for downstream consumers. Pinged @data-team to confirm backward compatibility.
Sam (PM): Current priority slate: 1) Fallback spec signoff, 2) Canary routing rollout, 3) Telemetry opt-in compatibility. Any objections or reorders?
Maya S.: Looks good to me. After the quick sync there should be no blockers.
Kevin T.: I'll merge after addressing Lina's comments.
Maya S.: Closing loop: I'll post a short rollout checklist doc with explicit rollback steps and perf assertions after merge. Thanks everyone.
